newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems unveils Sun Connect.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems unveils Sun Connect.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc said Monday it had unveiled Sun Connect, a Java-based architecture for web-based financial services.
"Financial services is moving to a web-based environment," said Rob Hall, vice president of worldwide financial services.

"Unlike some competitors that focus exclusively on the home banking/PC environment, Sun Connect embraces the coming world of smart cards, PDAs, network computers -- all of the devices that will let customers touch the financial institution," he said.

Sun Connect is a computer development environment using components entirely of the Java language which offers data security and rapid development of applications designed to run on virtually any computer system.

Financial service companies will be able to use the Web to reach customers on an architecture that is deployable on any hardware platform and that will support all industry-leading specifications for online transactions, such as the Open Financial Exchange, the company said.
